summary: Phase 2 E2E on Expo web preview (390x844 + 360x640) plus backend and Jest. Backend health/openapi passed 3/3, Jest passed 91/91. Almost every requested journey passed: onboarding + gift once, every menu nav button, collections purchase/ad/level locks, daily claim/clock rollback, missions claim once, shop coins/gems/real-money stub, inbox claim once + badge, profile rename/stats/leaderboard, settings persist (in-app nav), help/legal, reset, run speed 8.55 m/s, lanes/jump/slide, train roof y=2.6 with roof coins, pause menu + confirmations, double-tap hoverboard (x3->x2, HUD timer), revive 5 then 10 gems then straight to game over, decline/timeout to game over, coins banked exactly once. Found 1 CRITICAL data-loss bug: reloading or deep-linking any screen except /menu and /run wipes the save.

ui_bugs.issue: The claim Pressable (inbox-claim-welcome) sits inside the card Pressable (inbox-msg-*). On web this nests a <button> inside a <button>. It triggers a console error and a LogBox toast over the bottom of the menu in dev, and in testing a tap on Settings opened the LogBox instead.
Gift / shield / document Ionicons sit on the left of the card instead of centered, because the card uses alignItems: stretch.

integration_issues.flow: Reload or deep link on any screen except /menu and /run (settings, shop, collection, daily, missions, inbox, profile, help, legal)
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL DATA LOSS. Only menu.tsx and run.tsx check `ready` and redirect to '/'. Other screens render with defaultSave(): the settings header shows 0 coins / 0 gems and every toggle is back to default. The first action on that screen (for example toggle-sound) runs commit(default + change) and writes it to storage. That overwrites the real save, and the next launch goes to /onboarding with all progress lost. Reproduced: complete onboarding -> reload on /settings -> tap toggle-sound -> go to '/' -> sent to onboarding.
One hoverboard use is counted twice. consumeHoverboard() adds 1 to stats.powerupsUsed, then engine.activatePowerUp('hoverboard') adds 1 to e.powerupsUsed, and bankRun adds that again.

issues: A success toast covers the ScreenHeader (back button and balance) for several seconds after purchases or claims.
Segmented controls (graphics-*, language-*) do not expose aria-checked or aria-selected on web, so accessibilityState is not rendered.
Leo's 'Available soon' pill wraps onto 2 lines.

action_items: CRITICAL: Guard every screen until the save is loaded, so a cold load cannot overwrite storage with the default save. Either add `if (!ready) return <Redirect href='/' />` to each screen or put a ready gate in the root layout. Also make commit/persist a no-op while ready is false.
Stop counting a hoverboard use twice: drop the stats.powerupsUsed increment in consumeHoverboard, or don't count the hoverboard in engine.activatePowerUp.
inbox.tsx: move the claim button out of the card Pressable (or make the card a View with a separate header Pressable).
Center the icons on the onboarding steps (alignSelf: 'center').
critical_code_review_comments: GameProvider.update/commit persist whatever is in saveRef, even before init() has loaded data. This is the root cause of the data loss.
devFlags (clock offset, save failure) live only in memory and reset on reload. That is fine for dev, but the daily test has to navigate inside the app.
The dev-grant-coins button calls update() directly and bypasses applyTx and the ledger. It is dev-only, so this is acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (requested journeys pass; reload/deep-link data loss and a double-counted stat failed)

seed_data_creation: None; every browser context starts with empty storage
context_for_next_testing_agent: Close dialogs with <testID>-close (RewardDialog), <testID>-ok (PurchaseStatusDialog) or <testID>-confirm (ConfirmationDialog). The double-tap hoverboard only reacts to onTouchEnd, so dispatch TouchEvent touchstart/touchend on run-gesture-area; mouse clicks don't work. Navigate inside the app (header -back) to keep devFlags. To retest the data-loss fix: reload on /settings, then tap a toggle, then check the coins are kept.
rca_of_issue: app/_layout.tsx mounts every route under GameProvider with defaultSave. Only app/index.tsx calls init(), and only menu.tsx and run.tsx redirect to '/' when ready is false. On a web reload or deep link, other routes render the default state, and their actions call commit() -> persist() -> writeSave over the real save. Fix: a global ready gate plus blocking persist while not ready.
